Historical WEB-FI-001 fixtures, JSON minified without changing values:
- Seven FI envelopes: Git commit 756df5a, public/data/titanium_v2/football_intelligence/multileague/.
- Prediction matrix: Git commit 90ec6fe, public/data/titanium_v2/predictions/.
The Premier League session identifier is checked against the prediction filename by the test.

`synthetic_fe009.json` is a synthetic test envelope derived from one historical Serie A target and one standing above; its match identity is fictional and tests replace league metadata. It is not a GRE1 or Saudi producer artifact.
